heroPhotos.alt: The Tanjay City Government Center: a multi-storey building in glass and stone, with the city seal on its tower and a stepped plaza in front.
Rolling green hills scattered with houses, a paved road winding between them, and a mountain range beyond.
Officials in barong tagalog on the steps of the Government Center, one holding up a large ceremonial key lettered Tanjay City Government Center.
A large crowd assembled under a covered court, with sacks and boxes stacked in the foreground and uniformed officers in the front row.
A group standing behind a yellow ribbon stretched across a newly concreted road, with palms and greenery behind.
People standing outdoors with their right hands over their hearts during a flag ceremony, a flagpole and a building behind them.
Residents of all ages seated and standing together for a group photograph inside a decorated community hall.
Rows of young people in numbered white and gold jerseys performing together on a gymnasium floor.
